name: Is foreclosed property flooring different from a normal flooring replacement?
description: Yes. Foreclosed homes usually need more demo, cleanup, and prep than a normal flooring replacement.

mainEntity.name: Is foreclosed property flooring different from a normal flooring replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compared with a simple swap in an occupied home, foreclosed-property flooring work usually involves more demolition, cleanup, and repair. If the home has been vacant or weather-exposed, the contractor may need to address more unknowns before installation can begin.
